title: Asahina Mafuyu — The Staff Of Guidance〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: What lies behind. What lies ahead.

rows.Line: Diner

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, everyone!
You got your drinks ready?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Cheers!!
Great work!!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Cheers.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, yeah. Cheers.
Honestly, how are you always this excited during these things?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Oh, I haven't looked at our video since we uploaded it...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Ena and Mizuki were talking about how it was getting more views than usual on chat in Nightcord too...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (They're right. So many views and comments...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(But why...?
It's just another video...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Maybe the comments will tell me more...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What are you looking at on your phone, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Comment

rows.Speaker: The comments.
rows.Line:
<Wow! I didn't know they could make this kind of music!>
<It's a little different from what they usually do, but I really like it!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (A little different...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Kanade did mention something about not composing songs that are too similar to one another...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But I don't think that's what this person means by “different”...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa! You almost never do that, Mafuyu! So, what do you think?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: There are more comments here than usual.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, that? Not what everyone's been saying? Okay, sure but...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I wonder what Kanade thinks...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Our song is reaching all these people... I'm so glad...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Reaching...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Um, Kanade...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
What did you mean by that just now...?
“Reaching all these people...”

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm glad that our song's leaving such a positive impression on everyone...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A positive impression...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
You even said so yourself, Mafuyu.
You liked how warm this song felt.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was wondering if anyone else who listened to it would get the same impression.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But based on these comments, I can say for sure that we were able to “reach” them.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And I believe that your lyrics are reaching them too, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I just wrote those to make sure I don't forget what I felt that day...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm not doing this for someone else like you are, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That may be true, but your “someone” is you in your case...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Your lyrics are a reflection of what puzzles you the most and what you're facing right now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And I believe that's the reason your lyrics will also be able to reach all these people,

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I do.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Which is also why I think you should keep writing lyrics the way you have. For you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want you to tell me more about what you're feeling through your lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know if I'll be able to...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But okay. I'll try...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, sorry. We didn't mean to shut you two out.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, that's totally fine♪
We all get that this was a big step for Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We were also wondering if we should get another plate of fries. What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't care.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, well, I wasn't asking you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'd like some.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, that settles that♪
Excuse me! Can we get another order of fries?
